Definition: Zanoach, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Zanoah is named 5 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Joshua 15:34; 1 Chronicles 4:18; Nehemiah 3:13. In Joshua 15:34, the record says, "And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,". It is named again in Nehemiah 3:13: "The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof..."
TheologicalSignificance: Zanoah is a place God put on the map of his story, and I believe that matters.
